redOutputExcerpt: AssertionError: hook command could not locate runner from nested cwd
failureReason: Claude hook settings used a bare relative .cowork-flow/run path, so running the configured command from a nested cwd could not locate the runner.
whyThisTestMatters: Claude Code may execute hook commands from a directory other than the repository root; this test protects the user-visible UserPromptSubmit hook from failing before workflow-state injection starts.
